name: textbench-clickhouse
description: Indexes the TextBench OTel logs dataset via CREATE TABLE + INSERT and runs the ClickHouse-native SQL queries. Pair with --database-type=clickhouse and --workload-params '{"index_body": "clickhouse/index.json"}'. Note: substring / multiSearchAny replace BM25 match(), so hit counts diverge from the OS procedure -- see textbench/operations/clickhouse.json header.

name: textbench
description: Indexes the TextBench OTel logs dataset and runs OpenSearch PPL queries to benchmark full-text search and analytical performance on log data

name: textbench-search-only
description: Runs only the PPL search queries against an already-indexed TextBench dataset (skip ingest)
